summary: First QA iteration for ElectroGestor (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (users, categories, warranty ranges, products CRUD, search by brand/model, delete-category-with-products guard returns 400, warranty range matching). Frontend: full happy-path verified on 390x844 mobile viewport — onboarding (name only) persists and routes to tabs; Home shows categories with FAB + name prompt; new category created ('QA_Categoria_UI'); category screen groups brands (empty state); product-form fields (brand/model/price/sku/category chip/dynamic colors with add+remove+trash confirm) all work; LIVE warranty + SUMA update correctly against rules 0-500=S/25, 500-1000=S/50, 1000+=S/80 (verified prices 300→325, 750→800, 1500→1580); save with 2 colors routes to color-chooser; detail renders brand+model, color badge, price S/ 750.00, warranty, SUMA, SKU product/color/range, Cambiar color + Editar + Delete; global Buscar tab finds products by brand/model substring; es-PE 'S/ 1,299.90' formatting confirmed.

issues: RN-Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents), 'useNativeDriver not supported' — informational only on web preview, not blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate inline shadow* styles to boxShadow (or wrap in Platform.select) to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: avoid using props.pointerEvents (prefer style.pointerEvents) — minor RN-Web warning.

Nice-to-have: expose a stable testID on the search tab bar item and on the search TextInput ('search-input') to make E2E selectors deterministic (currently located via get_by_text('Buscar') and first <input>).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses soft-delete (deleted_at) consistently and correctly cascades range soft-deletes when a category is deleted. Good.
server.py excludes Mongo _id in projections — no serialization issues.
Category delete guard counts products with deleted_at: None — matches 'No se puede eliminar una categoría con equipos registrados'. Verified via test.
Frontend normalizeBrand() correctly strips accents and lowercases for grouping; UI preserves original casing for display (verified: 'SamSung' shown as-is, grouped under samsung).
findRange() uses half-open interval [min, max) which matches ranges 0-500/500-1000/1000+ exactly (boundary price = max goes to next range).
seed_data_creation: Created a 'QA_Categoria_UI' category with 3 warranty ranges (0-500=25/G25, 500-1000=50/G50, 1000+=80/G80) and one product 'SamSung Galaxy QA 42' (price 750, 2 colors Negro/Blanco) to validate flows. Pre-existing 'Celulares' category and 'Samsung Galaxy A54' product were also present. Backend pytest run creates/deletes its own TEST_* data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, so cross-class shared state must either live in a single class or be run with -n 0. For the UI, the name-prompt modal exposes testIDs name-prompt-input / name-prompt-submit; confirm dialog uses the text 'Sí' (confirm) and 'No'. There is no testID on the global Buscar tab or search TextInput — fallback to get_by_text('Buscar') and the first <input> after switching tabs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only informational RN-Web deprecation warnings.
